name: Brute Force Authentication Attack
description: Detects multiple failed login attempts from the same IP address within a short time window, indicating a brute force attack.
author: Security Team

alertTemplate.title: Brute Force Attack Detected
alertTemplate.description: Multiple failed login attempts detected from IP {actor.ipAddress} targeting user {actor.username}
recommendations: Block source IP address
Enable MFA for affected account
Review authentication logs for successful logins from same IP
Check if account credentials are compromised

name: Impossible Travel Detection
description: Detects successful authentications from geographically distant locations within a time frame impossible for physical travel.
query: eventType == "authentication" and details.result == "success" and enrichment.tags contains "impossible-travel"
author: Security Team

alertTemplate.title: Impossible Travel Detected
alertTemplate.description: User {actor.username} authenticated from {details.location} shortly after authenticating from a distant location
recommendations: Immediately invalidate user sessions
Force password reset
Contact user to verify recent authentication activity
Enable Conditional Access policies based on location
Review account activity for unauthorized actions

name: PowerShell Encoded Command Execution
description: Detects execution of PowerShell with encoded commands, often used to obfuscate malicious activity and evade detection.
query: eventType == "process_creation" and target.resource == "powershell.exe" and details.commandLine contains "EncodedCommand"
author: Security Team

alertTemplate.title: Suspicious PowerShell Execution Detected
alertTemplate.description: PowerShell executed with encoded command on {actor.hostname} by user {actor.username}
recommendations: Decode and analyze the PowerShell command
Isolate affected endpoint
Review parent process for malicious activity
Check for additional suspicious processes on the host
Implement PowerShell logging and script block logging

name: Credential Dumping Activity
description: Detects execution of known credential dumping tools (e.g., Mimikatz) or suspicious LSASS access patterns used to steal credentials.
query: eventType == "process_creation" and (target.resource contains "mimikatz" or enrichment.tags contains "credential-dumping" or enrichment.tags contains "lsass-access")
author: Security Team

alertTemplate.title: Credential Dumping Tool Detected
alertTemplate.description: Potential credential dumping activity detected on {actor.hostname} - process: {target.resource}
recommendations: Immediately isolate affected endpoint
Force password reset for all users on affected system
Review authentication logs for suspicious logins
Enable Credential Guard on Windows systems
Investigate parent process and command line arguments
Check for lateral movement from affected host

name: Shadow Copy Deletion (Ransomware Indicator)
description: Detects deletion of Volume Shadow Copies, a common ransomware preparation technique to prevent file recovery.
query: eventType == "file_access" and details.action == "delete" and target.resource contains "Shadow Cop"
author: Security Team

alertTemplate.title: Ransomware Preparation Detected
alertTemplate.description: Shadow copy deletion detected on {actor.hostname} - potential ransomware activity
recommendations: IMMEDIATELY isolate affected endpoint from network
Kill suspicious processes
Check for file encryption activity
Restore from clean backups if encryption occurred
Block execution of vssadmin.exe via AppLocker/WDAC
Hunt for additional compromised systems
Engage incident response team
